rationale: The proposed topology improves the binding constraints by adding a source degeneration inductor to the NMOS transistor, which enhances input matching (S11) and noise performance (NF) while maintaining gain (S21) and power efficiency. This modification directly targets the most negative margin (NF at -0.2572), which is the primary bottleneck, by increasing the effective source impedance to better match the 50Ω system and reduce noise figure through improved transconductance-to-noise ratio. The inductor also provides a resonant path at 5.8 GHz, enabling narrowband operation without degrading gain, and the topology remains within device budget and inductor limits.
